subject.title: feat(localization): add locale context and message rendering

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this shared core localization runtime and additive Gateway localization-descriptor contract as the foundation for the proposed five-PR series?
rationale: The patch creates new cross-surface package, protocol, automation, and presentation contracts; source review cannot determine the preferred long-term ownership and rollout policy.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed foundation
options.body: Accept the core direction, define the minimal first-slice contract and owner boundaries, then require rebase, real behavior proof, and review of that scoped patch.

options.title: Keep localization surface-owned
options.body: Retain existing per-surface localization paths and decline a shared runtime/protocol contract unless a concrete cross-surface gap proves it necessary.

options.title: Defer pending RFC decision
options.body: Pause this cumulative series until the related RFC establishes the intended product and plugin/core ownership model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrowed foundation
recommendation.body: Accept the core direction, define the minimal first-slice contract and owner boundaries, then require rebase, real behavior proof, and review of that scoped patch.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed localization series and can clarify or narrow the intended contract for owner review.
